clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. EO 9830, Part III, revokes the listed Executive orders, including No. 9200 (number and date of this order; OCR 'No. 9200 Of July 16, 1942.'). The enacting clause orders the whole of EO 9830 "it is hereby ordered as follows, effective May 1, 1947:" so the end is recorded as 1947-05-01. Part III has no separate date and the enacting clause orders Parts I, II and III alike 'effective May 1, 1947'; the alternative reading is that the revocation took effect on signing, 1947-02-24 (printed 12 FR 1259, 1947-02-25). The paragraph was restated 'to read as follows', which continued, as restated, until the order ended.

research_rationale:
Identity and text: read in full in the registered Federal Register original (7 FR 5503, issue of 1942-07-18, PDF page 1; grade original_representation_unverified, acceptable_as_original true). The order is headed 'Amending Subdivision II of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules', signed July 16, 1942, and restates paragraph 3 of Subdivision II (Department of State) to read: Chief and Assistant Chief of the Foreign Service Buildings Office and Chief of the Office of Foreign Service Furnishings. Inventory: the amending sentence and paragraph 3. End: EO 9830, Part III (official Federal Register text, 12 FR 1259, held with its PDF), "The following Executive orders are hereby revoked:" and the list includes No. 9200 (the OCR prints 'No. 9200 Of July 16, 1942.'), the number and date of this order. The dossier had no ACT record for this pair; the naming is supplied as the held excerpt SUPPLEMENT:FR9830P3 and the enacting clause as SUPPLEMENT:FR9830ENACT.

savings.reason: EO 9830 restates Schedule A with its own entry "(iii) Chief and Assistant Chief of the Foreign Service Buildings Office.", an independent command covering part of paragraph 3. The held restated Schedule A has no entry for the Chief of the Office of Foreign Service Furnishings (the word 'Furnishings' does not appear in the held text), so no independent continuation of that part is shown. EO 9830 has no savings wording for revoked orders.
